headline.caveat: Dollar value undisclosed — Humain discloses GPU counts and megawatts, not contract dollars. Program: ~600K NVIDIA GPUs over ~5 years for Saudi AI factories, starting with an initial 18K GB300 tranche (announced May 2025).

realized_to_date.caveat: Initial phases shipped/deploying (first AI factory tranches live 2026); cumulative spend unpublished. At list-price economics 600K GPUs would imply tens of billions of dollars, but no figure is on record.

nature_md: Humain's anchor silicon program: up to ~600K NVIDIA GPUs over roughly five years to build 'AI factories' of several hundred MW (500MW initially announced, within Humain's 6.6GW-by-2034 pipeline) in Saudi Arabia, beginning with 18K GB300 Grace Blackwell systems. xAI is contracted as an anchor tenant/first customer of a 500MW Humain data center running this compute (see related edge). Shipments require US export licenses granted under the 2025 US-Saudi AI framework — policy risk is structural. No dollar value has ever been disclosed; this is the tracker's canonical example of a MW-and-units-only sovereign deal (SPEC 9.2b).

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Humain capitalizes GPUs/systems as sovereign infrastructure funded by PIF; no public financials exist to verify commitments against payments.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: NVIDIA books data-center revenue on delivery under export license; sovereign orders diversify its hyperscaler concentration but add geopolitical revenue-recognition risk (licenses revocable). Customer-level dollars undisclosed in NVIDIA filings.
